spec.join: _cutcurve_arm_cells harvests the per-cut summary and the per-era level/band/part index; a cell present on one side only is reported, a cell moved is reported with its pointer
spec.dates: _cutcurve_widest_windows joins the widest window string per (cost, cut, era): a window either reproduces or it does not
spec.control: the same arm joined against itself; every cell must read delta 0.0 or the join machinery moved the numbers

cutoff_control.comparison: old raw arm vs today raw arm (arm held fixed)

answers.reading: the repair reaches the cut sweep: 2 widest windows move between the arms, so a window quoted without its arm is not reproducible

honest: descriptive census only: no gate, no verdict on the strategy, no prereg, no trial count, no ledger booking
the screened arm repairs prints inside the panel it is handed; it does not add or remove bars, so unchanged flip counts are a property of the repair, not evidence the panel is clean
level cells are expected to move and do not decide the verdict; the verdict is the widest-window join plus the same-arm control
cutcurve shares _livespan_setup with livespan, so this ticket covers the sweep only; run_livespan (E97 row 3) keeps its own ticket
